title: capsule.file.edit input
description: One exact atomic UTF-8 edit inside the kernel-issued private capsule: old_text and new_text replace the single occurrence of old_text, or content and preimage_sha256 write the whole file. The handler enforces UTF-8 byte ceilings, relative-component confinement, .git denial, symlink denial, a unique old_text, and the declared preimage immediately before replacement.

path.description: Capsule-relative file path. Absolute paths, empty/dot/dot-dot components, NUL, .git, oversized UTF-8 components, and symlink escape are denied by the confined file operation.

old_text.description: Exact text to replace, whitespace included; it must occur exactly once in the file.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 post-image, for a new file or a full rewrite (prefer old_text/new_text for an edit). Empty content is valid; the handler enforces the 65536-byte UTF-8 ceiling.

preimage_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the current file bytes, or null only when the target is required to be absent.
